## 3. Validation 2024: log-loss difference with 95% interval (resampled by tournament)

Negative = first model better. 'Clear' only if the whole interval is below 0.

| comparison | diff | low | high | clearly better? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Elo minus Always 50% | -0.0692 | -0.0893 | -0.0462 | yes |
| Standard Elo minus Rank baseline | -0.0089 | -0.0189 | -0.0001 | yes |
| Surface Elo minus Standard Elo | +0.0099 | +0.0010 | +0.0194 | worse |
| Blend (general+surface) minus Standard Elo | -0.0018 | -0.0055 | +0.0025 | no (interval includes 0) |

## 3b. Sensitivity: strict visibility (results released only after the tournament's maximum length)

Same settings, but a result is invisible to everything until `event_date + {'G': 14, 'M': 13, 'F': 8, 'O': 14, 'D': 4, 'A': 7}` days (by level) has passed, even inside its own tournament. This is the safest reading of the unknown dates; it costs the within-tournament information. A small gap means the round-order assumption barely matters.

| model | dev group rule | dev strict | val group rule | val strict | val strict - group | low | high |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Elo | 0.6172 | 0.6183 | 0.6240 | 0.6248 | +0.0009 | -0.0002 | +0.0020 |
| Blend (general+surface) | 0.6126 | 0.6138 | 0.6222 | 0.6230 | +0.0008 | -0.0005 | +0.0022 |

## 6. Diagnostics

- Consecutive tournament pairs per player whose nominal windows overlap (dev data): 4,559 of 43,403 (10.5%). Most are legitimate (lost early in a 2-week event, then played the next); the rule is only violated if a player's true order is the reverse of start-date order.
- Simultaneity groups: 3,237; largest group 131 matches. Group-wise updating makes a match blind to same-round results.
- A/B balance: A won 50.0% of dev matches (should be ~50%).
